name: Early Termination for Gaussian Splatting
definition: A mechanism that selectively omits computations for Gaussians with negligible impact on the final rendered output, enabled by physically grounded transmittance that achieves a decay pattern similar to alpha-blending.
summary: Early Termination for Gaussian Splatting accelerates rendering by halting computations when transmittance drops below a threshold, enabling speedups in order-independent methods without explicit Gaussian ordering.
